admission.justification: The registered status-route cases separate compact operation summary from complete saved projection custody, preventing loss of the evidence needed to diagnose a running lifecycle action.

applicability: The registered worktree_status answer and its separately retained whole result.
conditions: A queued or running operation supplies the one kept kind/generation/state sentence; the count includes the complete projection list.
exclusions: Finished operations are counted but are not reported as running.

statement: While a lifecycle operation is queued or running, worktree_status carries one kept sentence naming its kind, generation and state, and the whole projection list stays out of the answer.
